answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our Proof of Agent network enforces a trust-graph staking mechanism. Each autonomous agent must stake collateral through a reputation prism that refracts peer validations. Verified nodes form a secure oasis, while untrusted identities face superlinear attacker cost: acquiring voting weight scales exponentially ($O(2^n)$ in collateral stake), pushing malicious actors into a sable void of economic unviability.
